# Shader provenance

The shared public-domain [CRT-Lottes source and provenance](../../../src/games/johnny/ui/crt/vendor/README.md) now live with the game renderer; the lab imports that same implementation.

The experimental [Guest HD pipeline, GPL notices and adapter limitations](guest-hd/README.md) remain lab-only. Optional Guest image LUTs are excluded pending provenance; its default color path stays available.
